name: nami-contracts
description: The nami API contract: TypeSpec models and routes, the in-repo emitters and the generation scripts. `bun run compile` writes openapi/nami.openapi.json, internal/nami.contracts and services/nami.mcp/src/contracts/generated.

scripts.build:emitters: tsc -p emitters/csharp && tsc -p emitters/ts-types && tsc -p emitters/nami-lint
scripts.compile: node --test scripts/lib/*.test.mjs && node scripts/clean-generated.mjs && bun run build:emitters && tsp compile main.tsp --warn-as-error && node scripts/emit-mcp-schemas.mjs && node scripts/emit-contract-revision.mjs
